show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/N9tGGD
show.description: When an orphaned wrestling prodigy is betrayed by his guru’s jealous son and cursed to lose his strength at the worst moment, Kesari is left for dead—only to return as a broken, forgotten man. As love, legacy, and an ancient akhada hang in the balance, Kesari must reclaim his identity to defeat betrayal, destiny, and the past itself.
